name: Pyramid Recursive Ray Marching
definition: A multi-scale ray marching technique that starts at a low resolution (large scale) to initialize depth, then upsamples and refines the depth and SDF at higher resolutions (smaller scales) recursively.
summary: Pyramid Recursive Ray Marching is a multi-scale SDF acceleration technique that decouples coarse initialization from fine refinement, enabling larger steps in empty space while maintaining surface precision.
